markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (96%)** · Confident · Careful review
Single-class set and 5/5 similar cases agree; the MUSK second model disagrees. [F1]

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Benign 96%, In situ 4% | Benign clearly leads |
| Conformal set | {Benign} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.99 / 98th pct | No flag; modest error ranking |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | No | Top classes differ |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Benign | All neighbors agree |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 0) · ↓ invasive · Scarce; concept model associates it with lower invasion [F2] · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (region 2) · ↓ invasive · Typical level; same concept-model association [F4] · Weak
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 5) · ↓ invasive · Highest standardized score of nine concepts; spot check only 12/20 · Weak
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (region 4) · ↓ invasive · Typical level; 0/20 spot check [F3] · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Effect 0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007) includes 0, so not shown to reflect the classifier; mitoses is Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Simulated stain degradation (severity 3) distorts features; the MUSK second model picks another class.
- In situ (4%) is outside the conformal set, yet the duct-confined score is above typical.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 10, 11** — inferior margin segments score 0.996 and 0.81 (threshold 0.9998); confirm "clear" call.
2. **Region 5** — highest duct-confined score; look for atypical cells within ducts.
